default_open_mode.description: Default connection mode: 'anonymous' for anonymous login or 'usr' for username/password prompt.

anonymous_password.description: The password sent during anonymous FTP login, typically an email address.

blank_lines_between_cmds.description: Whether to insert blank lines between command prompts in the visual interface.

user_log_size.description: Max size in bytes for the transfer log file at ~/.ncftp/log. 0 disables logging.

max_bookmarks_to_save.description: Maximum number of site entries to retain in the bookmarks file.

pager.description: The command-line pager program used for displaying long lists or files.

progress_meter.description: Identifier for the type of progress meter to display during downloads/uploads.

remote_messages.description: Level of remote server messages: 'startup' shows server banner, 'none' hides extra chatter.

startup_in_local_dir.description: Local directory path to cd to upon NcFTP startup. Empty string means current directory.

startup_messages.description: Whether to display the startup splash screen and tips.

file_timestamps.description: Whether to preserve remote file modification times on downloaded local files.

screen_graphics.description: Enable visual/curses mode. Set to false to force line mode.

bookmarks.description: A list of predefined site bookmarks for quick access. Items must be maps containing: name, host, remote_dir, user, password, transfer_type, passive_ftp.
